$comment: Offline corpus release assets, verified by `fetch-corpus` (ADR-008/ADR-009).
`bytes` and `sha256` here are the contract: a download that does not match
them is rejected and any existing data is left untouched.
`basis` is REQUIRED and records why the asset may be redistributed at all:
upstream_public - the dataset is public and anonymously downloadable (ADR-008)
community_owned - the community's own scraping output, distributed because its
author holds the rights to that output (ADR-009). Whether the
upstream site needs a credentialed session is irrelevant here.
Adding an asset without `basis` is refused at install time; the two grounds must
not be conflated, or ADR-006's boundary quietly disappears.
then upload the tar.gz to the GitHub Release named in `url` and commit this file.

chictr_pancreatic.title: ChiCTR 胰腺癌离线语料
chictr_pancreatic.note: ChiCTR 公开登记信息离线快照；数据版权归 ChiCTR，本服务仅作搬运与只读索引。

xyb_cde_pancreatic.title: 小胰宝 CDE 胰腺癌社区归档
xyb_cde_pancreatic.note: 小胰宝社区自行抓取并整理的 CDE 胰腺癌数据包（结构化 JSON + 原始 HTML 快照 + 网页导出 DOC/DOCX）；分发依据是社区对该抓取成果自身拥有分发权（ADR-009）。上游站点为受控来源，本包不是上游官方数据集，登记信息可能被随时修订。

ctv_index.title: CTV（Veeva）本地检索索引
ctv_index.note: 小胰宝社区自建的 CTV（Veeva Clinical Trial Viewer）本地检索索引快照，由 ctv-mcp-server 的 sitemap/GraphQL 同步流程生成；分发依据是社区对该索引成果自身拥有分发权（ADR-009）。上游 ctv.veeva.com 的 robots.txt 禁止抓取 /study-search，本索引不是上游官方数据集，且其零结果只代表"不在本索引内"，不代表试验不存在。
